column1: # 3.11 versions of shared presets (packages/basilisk-synth/library/presets), replacing them in place in BASILISK 16's
# program list and \PRESETS.TSV, where 3.11's Sound Recorder needs a different recipe.
# Chord Thump: `]` after `<<` is at position 0 on 3.11 (a refused step), so the slowed chord needs one `<` and gain.
# Critical Bass: critstop's 42 ms lead-in, slowed 4x and an octave down, hides short notes: trimmed (`@t40[`) first.
